history.title: Appointment History Storage
history.subtitle: Each appointment's history (who changed what, and when) is kept in the database while it is recent. Once an appointment is long past, its history moves to file storage, so the database does not keep growing. It still shows on the appointment as before. One daily run for all your businesses, at a quiet time in your time zone.
